transcription_cross_check: All 517 included source transcription lines retain their exact original bytes. Every included physical source page (2 and 4–22) was visually reviewed. OCR source-to-Web and native Web-to-source checks are recorded separately with every low-confidence candidate resolved against its original page. Back-contact copy is additionally bound to physical page 22.
revision_scope: Front cover and paper TOC excluded by explicit operator scope. Restored EN next to IMPORTANT and the back contact address, source frame/icons/QR, and native telephone/email/website.

Restored two safety columns and the exact inside-item column break. FCC was already two columns and remains so. Warranty source has two columns only inside the 3/2 YEARS period panel; its other sections remain full width. The old blanket claim was inaccurate.

Restored compact IMPORTANT badge/title, dark safety subsection bars, and four App subsection dots. Chapter bars and other source hierarchy remain native with the shared theme. Responsive line wrapping and vertical spacing are not fixed PDF pagination.

Top WARNING/DANGER use their exact source frame and warning mark with selectable copy. The basic WARNING card occupies the left column top only; bullets remain outside. Grounding WARNING is a plain bold lead followed by its source bullet. Other source side-label CAUTION/NOTE/WARNING callouts retain native label/body relationships.

Restored all six source panel copy placements, including power standby, AC/DC prerequisites, AC outlet note, LED modes and three original step rows, energy-saving instruction, AC charging caption. Exact source asset rectangles are in asset_recipe.json and layout-positions.css. Native copy remains editable; source artwork is not drawn or rasterized as complete pages.

Native mode/key tables preserve source row order and button/description association. Restored all four plus signs and exact original clock glyphs. Desktop fits the reading rail; phone scrolls internally without changing row associations.

Signal labels use the own-PDF triangle rather than a generic drawn mark; words and meanings remain native. Source 4+3 pictogram tables remain side by side on desktop. All seven admitted symbol assets pass the existing own-PDF admission threshold.

Restored LCD number 23 spanning high/low temperature rows, original two-row USB-C label span, and F7 V_oc subscript. Source troubleshooting steps remain separate lines; all source values remain unchanged.
FCC native two-column paragraph/list block retains its source mark. Navigation-only FCC title remains visually hidden. No RF or ISED text is added; this source has neither.

Complete source leader/port/nameplate/screen panels remain the same model artwork. Every existing asset decision is rechecked against own-source recipe/hash or the symbol-admission evidence, rather than treated as approval. Native moved body text is overlaid in its original panel rectangles.
